method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: SK Hynix shares tank as exponential earnings growth fails to satisfy AI-charged expectations
Equities.summary: SK Hynix shares fell as exponential profit and revenue growth failed to meet analysts' lofty expectations for a darling of the artificial intelligence sector.
Equities.reason: Company-level miss for a key AI memory supplier has become a focal point for a broader chip/AI unwind. High relevance because SK Hynix is a bellwether for memory demand and the story is driving cross-market risk-off in semiconductors and related tech.

Equities.title: Asian technology stocks extend sell-off with SoftBank down 10% as AI plays take a hit
Equities.summary: Chinese internet stocks listed in Hong Kong bucked the broader regional weakness with Tencent, Meituan, Baidu and Kuaishou all trading higher.
Equities.reason: Regional tech rout centered on AI/chip names; signals contagion beyond single names into broader Asian tech, amplifying global risk-off for growth/AI leadership.

Equities.title: Asian Stocks Drop as Chip Rout Deepens, Oil Gains: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Market wrap highlighting deepening chip sell-off and regional equity weakness — reinforces a dominant negative narrative for semiconductors and pressure on global tech indexes.

Equities.title: Hedge funds face demands to stump up collateral as AI stocks tumble
Equities.summary: Scale of losses in recent weeks sparks growing risk aversion on Wall Street
Equities.reason: Margin/collateral pressure at hedge funds escalates forced selling risk and liquidity stress in AI/semiconductor positions — high relevance to market regime and volatility.

Equities.title: Bank of England probes Asian equity risk at prime brokers
Equities.summary: Regulator to review exposure to AI sector at hedge funds and other clients of investment banks operating in UK
Equities.reason: Regulatory scrutiny of concentrated AI exposure increases institutional caution and could tighten funding/prime-broker conditions — moderates risk appetite.

Equities.title: Equal-Weight S&P 500 Hits Record; Broad Gains Outweigh Chip Rout
Equities.reason: Equal‑weight S&P hitting records signals breadth and rotation beyond mega-cap semiconductors; tempers pure chip-led bear narrative and is relevant to overall market resilience.

Equities.title: Apple touches $5 trillion market cap for first time
Equities.summary: The jockeying between Apple and Nvidia reflects a debate about the future of AI that has preoccupied investors this summer.
Equities.reason: Major-cap leadership (Apple/Nvidia) remains a structural support for indices; milestone underscores concentration in a few tech names and the market’s AI leadership narrative.

Equities.title: S&P 500 futures edge lower as oil climbs after Iran attack; South Korea stocks fall over 8%
Equities.reason: Geopolitical shock (Iran-related) causing near-term risk-off and intersecting with chip weakness — relevant to short-term equity futures and risk sentiment.

Equities.title: Iran launches surprise ballistic missile attack on U.S. forces in the Middle East
Equities.summary: Centcom in a post on X said that the attack originated from Iran, but all missiles were intercepted.
Equities.reason: Direct geopolitical event increases downside tail risk for risk assets and can amplify volatility and sector rotation (energy vs. tech) in equities.

Equities.title: Morning Bid: Chip rout moves into pAnIc territory
Equities.reason: Authoritative market commentary framing the chip sell-off as escalating panic — supports negative market-regime view and heightened volatility expectations.

Equities.title: Investors Rotate Out of Chip Stocks
Equities.reason: Flow-driven rotation signal: selling pressure in semiconductors with reallocations elsewhere. Relevant as a medium-strength modifier to the chip-led risk narrative.

Rates.title: Australian Dollar slips as softer inflation cools domestic rate expectations
Rates.summary: AUD/USD depreciates for the second successive day, trading around 0.6970 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair falls as the Australian Dollar (AUD) continues to struggle following the release of domestic Consumer Price Index (CPI) data.
Rates.reason: Softer Australian CPI is being priced as lowering the RBA tightening path — supportive for Australian bond prices (yields down). FX headline references domestic rate expectations, so moderate positive impact for rates.

Rates.title: Australia’s CPI inflation cools to 3.8% YoY in June vs. 4% forecast
Rates.summary: Australia’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) increased by 3.8% year-over-year (YoY) in June, compared to a 4% growth reported in May, the latest data published by the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) showed on Wednesday.
Rates.reason: Actual CPI slowdown is a material domestic data beat for bond markets — reduces RBA rate-hike odds and term premia, implying lower Australian yields (positive for bonds).

Rates.title: United States: Supercore and measurement debates shape Fed path – BNY
Rates.summary: BNY strategists John Velis and David Tam see elevated US supercore inflation as a key argument for further tightening but still favor a July hold.
Rates.reason: Elevated US 'supercore' inflation arguments point toward a higher-for-longer Fed path, keeping upward pressure on US yields (negative for bond prices). This shapes market pricing for Fed tightening beyond near-term holds.

Rates.title: Citadel Securities’ Fed Rate Hike Call Adds to Market Angst
Rates.reason: A high-profile market participant calling for further Fed hikes increases perceived tightening risk and market angst, likely keeping upward pressure on US yields and risk premia.

Rates.title: BIS says AI boom risks clouding central banks' inflation signals
Rates.reason: BIS warning that AI-related demand shifts could obscure inflation signals raises uncertainty for policy decisions — likely to elevate term premia and add modest upward pressure to yields (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: ECB to start implementing enhanced repo facility for central banks
Rates.reason: ECB introducing an enhanced repo facility for central banks is a liquidity-support measure that can ease money-market strains and be modestly supportive for euro-area bond prices (yields lower).

Rates.title: Singapore Dollar: MAS tightening keeps pair under pressure – Commerzbank
Rates.summary: Commerzbank analysts highlight that the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) unexpectedly tightened policy for a second straight meeting, slightly increasing the Singapore Dollar (SGD) Nominal Effective Exchange Rate (NEER) slope while leaving the band’s cent
Rates.reason: MAS unexpected tightening implies a tighter domestic rates backdrop in Singapore, which lifts local yields and tightens regional liquidity — negative for Singapore bond prices and relevant to Asia rates pricing.

Rates.title: Indonesia: Policy focus after BI Governor exit – DBS
Rates.summary: DBS Group Research economist Radhika Rao analyzes Indonesia markets after Bank Indonesia Governor Perry Warjiyo’s unexpected resignation. She notes initial weakness in onshore assets as investors reassess implications for Rupiah stability and bonds.
Rates.reason: Unexpected Bank Indonesia governor exit raises political and policy uncertainty, prompting outflows/reevaluation of rupiah and local bonds — upward pressure on Indonesian yields and wider emerging-market rate premia.

FX.title: Euro advances as US Dollar declines ahead of Fed policy decision
FX.summary: EUR/USD holds ground for the second successive day, trading around 1.1390 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.
FX.reason: EURUSD strength tied to broad USD softness ahead of the FOMC; high relevance because majors are trading on Fed anticipation and this reinforces the prevailing USD-weaken narrative.

FX.title: British Pound gains ground as US Dollar struggles ahead of Fed decision
FX.summary: GBP/USD edges higher after remaining flat in the previous day, trading around 1.3300 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency pair gains ground as the US Dollar (USD) struggles ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) upcoming policy decision.
FX.reason: GBPUSD up on USD weakness into the FOMC; adds to the cross-market theme of dollar caution and is relevant for G10 FX flows ahead of the meeting.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar remains on the front foot as USD bulls turn cautious ahead of Fed decision
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair is seen consolidating around the 1.4100 mark during the Asian session as traders keenly await the outcome of a two-day FOMC policy meeting, due later this Wednesday.
FX.reason: CAD on the front foot as USD bulls pause into the FOMC; relevant because USD/CAD is sensitive to both Fed-driven USD moves and commodity/Oil-linked CAD flows.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah gains as Fed uncertainty weighs on US Dollar
FX.summary: USD/IDR depreciates after two days of gains, trading around 18,120 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. However, the pair has lost ground as the US Dollar (USD) struggles ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) upcoming policy decision.
FX.reason: Emerging market FX (IDR) firming on Fed uncertainty and a softer USD; useful as a cross-check that USD caution is broad-based beyond G10.

FX.title: Indian Rupee fails to extend winning streak as oil prices bounce back
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens marginally lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday after a three-day winning streak. The USD/INR pair rebounds to near 95.85 as oil prices have rebounded strongly due to revived geopolitical risks.
FX.reason: Oil-driven INR weakness implies USD strength versus INR; this is a commodity/FX transmission (oil bounce from geopolitical risk) and serves as a localized USD-supportive counter-signal.

FX.title: Japanese Yen holds ground despite rising oil prices
FX.summary: USD/JPY loses ground after registering minor gains in the previous day, trading around 163.70 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair may regain ground as the Japanese Yen could come under pressure from rebounding oil prices.
FX.reason: JPY holding/strengthening (USD/JPY down) within the wider pre-FOMC backdrop; relevant because JPY often reacts to risk and safe-haven flows and influences cross-asset positioning.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index (DXY) flat below 101.50 as bulls await FOMC amid Iran risks
FX.summary: The United States Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, is seen consolidating below the 101.50 level during the Asian session as traders await the outcome of a two-day FOMC meeting, due later this Wednesday.
FX.reason: DXY consolidation below 101.50 signals USD caution/softness into the FOMC, though mention of Iran risks keeps the picture mixed; high relevance as DXY movement is the central FX market driver ahead of the meeting.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar holds steady below 0.5900 vs USD as traders seem hesitant ahead of FOMC
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair struggles to build on the overnight bounce from the 0.5860 horizontal support and seesaws between tepid gains/minor losses during the Asian session on Wednesday.
FX.reason: NZD largely moving on USD dynamics into the FOMC; modest relevance as it reinforces the broad dollar-centric, FOMC-driven market environment.

FX.title: The Australian Dollar sells a speech and waits for the number that decides August
FX.summary: The Aussie trades just beneath 0.7000 on Tuesday, down around 0.25% and last in the G10 queue, after a Sydney address from the Reserve Bank of Australia's Governor gave the hike case nothing to eat.
FX.reason: AUD underperforming after RBA commentary dented the hawkish case; relevant as local central bank tone is affecting AUDUSD within the broader USD/Fed-driven session.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD gains even as oil prices rebound, Fed policy awaited
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades 1.14% higher to near $57.80 during the Asian trading session on Wednesday. The white metal gains even as oil prices rebound strongly due to renewed conflicts between the United States (US) and Iran.
Commodities.reason: Silver up modestly as safe-haven/physical precious metals demand responds to geopolitical-driven oil strength; small positive for silver prices.

Commodities.title: Gold bounces off one-week low as USD bulls turn cautious ahead of FOMC decision
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) recovers slightly from the vicinity of the $4,000 psychological mark, or an over one-week low touched during the Asian session on Wednesday, amid a modest US Dollar (USD) downtick.
Commodities.reason: Modest safe-haven demand and USD softness support gold; near-term impact is limited but positive for bullion.

Commodities.title: Energia Costa Azul, Mexico's second LNG terminal, shipped first cargo
Commodities.summary: Energia Costa Azul, the second liquefied natural gas (LNG) export facility in Mexico, shipped its initial cargo from Phase 1 of the terminal on July 8, according to the project developer. The completion of the project adds 0.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d
Commodities.reason: New Mexican LNG export capacity adds marginal global gas supply (0.4 Bcf/d); modest negative impulse for natural gas prices.

Commodities.title: Commercial crude oil inventories increased by 2.0 million barrels
Commodities.summary: For the week ending July 17, 2026, commercial crude oil inventories (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) increased 2.0 million barrels to 411.7 million barrels, 6% below the previous five-year (2021–2025) average. Gasoline inventories increased 0.8 mill
Commodities.reason: Weekly crude stock build is a near-term bearish data point for oil, though inventories remain below the five-year average; represents a counter-signal to geopolitical-driven price upside.

Commodities.title: US CENTCOM launches strikes in Iraq targeting Iran-backed groups
Commodities.summary: US Central Command: carried out precision strikes in Iraq targeting Iran-backed groups planning attacks on US forces and Saudi oil facilities.
Commodities.reason: Direct strikes tied to groups planning attacks on Saudi oil facilities raise supply-risk premium for oil; clear positive for crude and energy complex.

Commodities.title: Oil jumps as U.S.-Iran resume strikes after a brief pause
Commodities.summary: Oil rose sharply amid renewed tensions in the Middle East after Iran launched an attack on U.S. forces using ballistic missiles.
Commodities.reason: Market-moving report: renewed U.S.-Iran strikes have driven a sharp oil price jump via heightened Middle East supply-risk and risk premium buildup.

Commodities.title: Oil Surges After Three-Day Drop as US Repels Iran Attack on Base
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg wrap: geopolitical escalation reversing a prior downturn in oil, reinforcing a strong, market-wide risk premium for crude.

Commodities.title: The Iran War Just Put Another Key Oil Route at Risk
Commodities.reason: Risk to major shipping route increases potential logistics disruptions and adds to oil risk premia; meaningful positive for crude.

Commodities.title: U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve faces stress as emergency releases strain old infrastructure
Commodities.summary: The reserve has an authorized storage capacity of 714 million barrels, according to the Department of Energy.
Commodities.reason: SPR drawdowns and operational strain signal lower strategic buffer and potential for tighter physical market conditions, supportive for oil prices.

Commodities.title: Ukraine adapts strikes on Russian energy industry to hit critical components
Commodities.summary: Kyiv is shifting its long-range drone campaign to keep plants offline for longer
Commodities.reason: Targeted strikes on Russian energy infrastructure raise European supply risk for oil/gas, adding to the broader energy risk premium.

Commodities.title: U.S. to import Mexican cattle again. Here’s what that means for high beef prices
Commodities.reason: Resumption of Mexican cattle imports increases U.S. supply for beef/live cattle, modestly bearish for cattle prices.

Commodities.title: Crude Oil Prices Sink on Hopes for US-Iran Diplomacy
Commodities.reason: Diplomatic hopes briefly weighed on oil prices; included as a lower-relevance counter-signal to ongoing geopolitical-driven upside.

Crypto.title: 'Anything remotely dovish' from Fed could be good for bitcoin, says analyst
Crypto.reason: Macro policy is a dominant driver for crypto; any Fed dovish pivot eases financial conditions and historically supports bitcoin risk appetite. High relevance as macro liquidity/yields are market-wide flows into crypto.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin rises toward $64,000 as Korea's record chip crash leaves crypto untouched
Crypto.reason: Spot bitcoin strength and decoupling from an equity-sector shock signal short-term positive momentum for BTC; relevant but single-session price action so moderate relevance.

Crypto.title: Coinbase wants to be Canada’s ‘everything exchange,’ but says clearer rules are needed first
Crypto.reason: Exchange expansion into Canada is adoption-positive, but the firm's call for clearer rules tempers the impact; relevant to institutional custody/trading footprint.

Crypto.title: Ondo drops tokenized asset blockchain plans for private, high-speed trading network
Crypto.reason: A material firm backing away from public tokenized-asset rails is a mild negative signal for the tokenization narrative and on-chain institutional asset flows; modest relevance.

Crypto.title: Wall Street veteran Don Wilson says regulators are getting perps all wrong
Crypto.reason: Industry voices defending perpetuals can ease regulatory pressure and support the derivatives market, but it's an opinion piece with limited direct market impact.

Crypto.title: BlackRock, Fidelity, other Wall Street giants back the Clarity Act
Crypto.reason: Major institutional support for a regulatory clarity bill materially boosts the institutionalization narrative for crypto products; high relevance but tempered by legislative uncertainty.

Crypto.title: Ethereum startup EthSystems bets privacy is key to getting banks on public blockchains
Crypto.reason: Privacy tooling aimed at bank adoption supports broader on-chain institutional use cases for Ethereum; meaningful technical adoption signal for DeFi/enterprise flows.

Crypto.title: Russia outlines new digital depository rules ahead of fall crypto framework roll-out
Crypto.reason: Signaling of a formal domestic framework in a large jurisdiction can be incremental positive for local market infrastructure; relevance is limited to regional impact and details pending.

Crypto.title: Hyperliquid is taking crypto perps deep into DeFi’s ‘money LEGO’ land
Crypto.reason: Onchain perpetuals expanding into composable DeFi is an innovation-positive signal for derivatives liquidity and new product flows, but carries execution and risk considerations.

Crypto.title: Zcash seals $1.7 billion shielded pool as Ironwood upgrade activates
Crypto.reason: A major privacy upgrade and large shielded pool increase onchain privacy liquidity and usage for privacy-focused protocols; positive but niche to broader market.

Crypto.title: Morgan Stanley debuts ether, solana exchange-traded products after bitcoin fund success
Crypto.reason: Major bank launching ETH and SOL ETPs is a strong institutionalization and product-distribution positive for altcoins and broader crypto capital inflows; high relevance and market-moving for adoption.

Crypto.title: Core Scientific lands AMD AI deal as bitcoin mining operation winds down
Crypto.reason: A large miner winding down bitcoin operations points to structural pain in the mining sector; landing an AI deal is a pivot away from crypto revenue, net negative for mining demand.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin’s recent stability hasn't been enough to spark a broader altcoin rally
Crypto.reason: Lack of altcoin breadth despite BTC stability signals fragile speculative conviction beyond BTC; negative for altcoin market momentum and liquidity.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin drops as South Korean stocks tumble, Senate shelves crypto Clarity Act
Crypto.reason: Market reaction tied to legislative setback (Clarity Act shelved) is a meaningful negative—regulatory delay reduces institutional product clarity and can impair flows into crypto.

Crypto.title: Perpetuals tied to SK Hynix hit by flash crash to $900 on Hyperliquid
Crypto.reason: Flash crash in onchain perpetuals highlights execution and counterparty risk in DeFi derivatives, a material negative for risk-sensitive capital allocating to leveraged crypto products.

Crypto.title: BitMEX and BitMart may be first casualties of crypto trading slump
Crypto.reason: Potential exchange casualties from a trading-volume slump are a significant negative for market structure, liquidity and counterparty confidence—high relevance to crypto markets.

Crypto.title: Inside the CME and CFTC’s battle over onchain perpetual futures
Crypto.reason: Regulatory conflict over onchain perpetuals creates policy uncertainty for derivatives innovation and could restrict institutional product development—material but nuanced impact.

Crypto.title: Live updates: Crypto climbs off worst levels as stock selloff is contained to AI names
Crypto.reason: Short-term recovery after a selloff indicates some resilience and contained correlation with equity dislocations; useful intraday signal with limited lasting impact.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin slides 2% after U.S. close while Korea’s Kospi plunges 10%
Crypto.reason: Price weakness linked to major equity-market stress in Korea shows cross-asset sensitivity and short-term negative pressure on BTC liquidity and risk sentiment.

Crypto.title: U.S. Senate puts off crypto Clarity Act for now as it focuses limited bandwidth elsewhere
Crypto.reason: Legislative delay on a clarity bill is a negative for institutionalization and product rollout timelines; significant regulatory news that weighs on flows into crypto.

Crypto.title: Kalshi, Polymarket win pause against Minnesota's prediction market ban
Crypto.reason: Court wins for prediction markets protect an onchain business model and reduce regulatory tail-risk for that segment; positive legal precedent with moderate relevance.
